import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded ∧
  -- Undirected: if u→v with weight w exists, then so does v→u with the same weight
  (∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → graph.has_edge v u w)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- All graph edges leaving the current tree: `u` visited, `p.1` not visited. -/
def crossEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (visited : List Nat) : List MSTEdge :=
  visited.flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filter (fun p => !visited.contains p.1)).map
      (fun p => ⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩))

/-- Minimum-weight element of a list of candidate edges (first strict minimum). -/
def pickMin (l : List MSTEdge) : Option MSTEdge :=
  l.foldl (fun best e =>
    match best with
    | none => some e
    | some b => if e.w < b.w then some e else some b) none

/-- Reachability through the accumulated (undirected) tree edges. -/
def Reach (acc : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (edges_contain acc) u v

/-- Prim's main loop: `k` remaining vertices to absorb. -/
def primLoop (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → List Nat → List MSTEdge → List MSTEdge
  | 0, _, acc => acc
  | k + 1, visited, acc =>
    match pickMin (crossEdges g visited) with
    | none => acc
    | some e => primLoop g k (e.v :: visited) (e :: acc)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def prim_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : prim_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  primLoop graph (graph.size - 1) [0] []
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : prim_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-! ### Group A: weight plumbing -/

theorem total_weight_foldl (l : List MSTEdge) (a : Int) :
    l.foldl (fun sum e => sum + e.w) a = a + (l.map MSTEdge.w).sum := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x t ih => simp [ih]; ring

theorem total_weight_eq_sum (l : List MSTEdge) :
    total_weight l = (l.map MSTEdge.w).sum := by
  simp [total_weight, total_weight_foldl]

theorem total_weight_cons (e : MSTEdge) (l : List MSTEdge) :
    total_weight (e :: l) = e.w + total_weight l := by
  simp [total_weight_eq_sum]

theorem total_weight_perm {l₁ l₂ : List MSTEdge} (h : l₁.Perm l₂) :
    total_weight l₁ = total_weight l₂ := by
  simp [total_weight_eq_sum, (h.map MSTEdge.w).sum_eq]

/-! ### Group B: `pickMin` and `crossEdges` -/

theorem pickMin_foldl (l : List MSTEdge) (b : MSTEdge) :
    ∃ e, l.foldl (fun best e =>
        match best with
        | none => some e
        | some b => if e.w < b.w then some e else some b) (some b) = some e ∧
      (e = b ∨ e ∈ l) ∧ e.w ≤ b.w ∧ ∀ c ∈ l, e.w ≤ c.w := by
  induction l generalizing b with
  | nil => exact ⟨b, rfl, Or.inl rfl, le_refl _, by simp⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : a.w < b.w
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hmem, hle, hmin⟩ := ih a
      refine ⟨e, by simpa [h] using he, ?_, le_trans hle (le_of_lt h), ?_⟩
      · rcases hmem with rfl | hm
        · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
      · intro c hc
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
        · exact hle
        · exact hmin c hc
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hmem, hle, hmin⟩ := ih b
      refine ⟨e, by simpa [h] using he, ?_, hle, ?_⟩
      · rcases hmem with rfl | hm
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
      · intro c hc
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
        · exact le_trans hle (not_lt.1 h)
        · exact hmin c hc

theorem pickMin_spec {l : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} (h : pickMin l = some e) :
    e ∈ l ∧ ∀ c ∈ l, e.w ≤ c.w := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [pickMin] at h
  | cons a t =>
    obtain ⟨e', he', hmem, hle, hmin⟩ := pickMin_foldl t a
    have hp : pickMin (a :: t) = t.foldl (fun best e =>
        match best with
        | none => some e
        | some b => if e.w < b.w then some e else some b) (some a) := rfl
    rw [hp, he'] at h
    obtain rfl : e' = e := Option.some.inj h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases hmem with rfl | hm
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm
    · intro c hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
      · exact hle
      · exact hmin c hc

theorem pickMin_isSome {l : List MSTEdge} (h : l ≠ []) : ∃ e, pickMin l = some e := by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t =>
    obtain ⟨e', he', _⟩ := pickMin_foldl t a
    exact ⟨e', he'⟩

/-- A nonempty adjacency row can only occur at an in-range index. -/
theorem lt_size_of_mem_adj {g : WeightedGraph} {u : Nat} {p : Nat × Int}
    (h : p ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]) : u < g.size := by
  by_contra hu
  have hu' : ¬ u < g.adj.size := by simpa [WeightedGraph.size] using hu
  simp [Array.getD, hu'] at h

theorem mem_crossEdges {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : List Nat} {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e ∈ crossEdges g visited) :
    e.u ∈ visited ∧ e.v ∉ visited ∧ g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w := by
  rw [crossEdges, List.mem_flatMap] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩ := h
  rw [List.mem_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hmem
  rw [List.mem_filter] at hp
  obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
  rw [Array.mem_toList_iff] at hp1
  refine ⟨hu, ?_, lt_size_of_mem_adj hp1, p, hp1, rfl, rfl⟩
  simpa using hp2

theorem crossEdges_subset_visited {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : List Nat} {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e ∈ crossEdges g visited) : e.u ∈ visited ∧ e.v ∉ visited :=
  ⟨(mem_crossEdges h).1, (mem_crossEdges h).2.1⟩

/-- Backward direction: every graph edge leaving the visited set is a candidate. -/
theorem crossEdges_of_has_edge {g : WeightedGraph} {visited : List Nat} {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (hu : u ∈ visited) (hv : v ∉ visited) (he : g.has_edge u v w) :
    (⟨u, v, w⟩ : MSTEdge) ∈ crossEdges g visited := by
  obtain ⟨-, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := he
  rw [crossEdges, List.mem_flatMap]
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [List.mem_map]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨Array.mem_toList_iff.2 hp, ?_⟩
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', List.contains_eq_mem, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    rw [hp1]; exact hv
  · rw [MSTEdge.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨rfl, hp1, hp2⟩

/-! ### Group E: invariant 3 — every emitted edge is a real graph edge -/

theorem primLoop_valid (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (visited : List Nat) (acc : List MSTEdge),
      (∀ e ∈ acc, e.is_valid g) → ∀ e ∈ primLoop g k visited acc, e.is_valid g := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro visited acc h; simpa [primLoop] using h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro visited acc h
    cases hp : pickMin (crossEdges g visited) with
    | none => simpa [primLoop, hp] using h
    | some e =>
      have hgoal : primLoop g (k + 1) visited acc = primLoop g k (e.v :: visited) (e :: acc) := by
        simp [primLoop, hp]
      rw [hgoal]
      apply ih
      intro f hf
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hf with rfl | hf
      · exact (mem_crossEdges (pickMin_spec hp).1).2.2
      · exact h f hf

/-! ### Group C: bridge between `getD`-indexed paths and `List.IsChain` -/

theorem chain'_of_getD {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} (d : α) :
    ∀ p : List α, (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → R (p.getD i d) (p.getD (i + 1) d)) →
      List.IsChain R p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; first | trivial | constructor
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    cases t with
    | nil => first | trivial | constructor
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
      refine ⟨by simpa using h 0 (by simp), ih ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      simpa using h (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)

theorem getD_of_chain' {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} (d : α) :
    ∀ p : List α, List.IsChain R p →
      ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → R (p.getD i d) (p.getD (i + 1) d) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h i hi
    cases t with
    | nil => simp at hi
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa using h.1
      | succ j => simpa using ih h.2 j (by simpa using hi)

/-- Along any chain that starts inside `V` and ends outside `V`, some step leaves `V`. -/
theorem exists_step_out {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {V : List Nat} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (a z : Nat), List.IsChain R p → p.head? = some a →
      p.getLast? = some z → a ∈ V → z ∉ V → ∃ x y, R x y ∧ x ∈ V ∧ y ∉ V := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro a z _ hh _ _ _; simp at hh
  | cons b t ih =>
    intro a z hc hh hl ha hz
    obtain rfl : b = a := by simpa using hh
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hbz : b = z := by simpa using hl
      exact absurd (hbz ▸ ha) hz
    | cons c t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
      by_cases hcV : c ∈ V
      · exact ih c z hc.2 rfl (by simpa using hl) hcV hz
      · exact ⟨b, c, hc.1, ha, hcV⟩

/-- The loop can always make progress while some vertex is unvisited. -/
theorem crossEdges_ne_nil {g : WeightedGraph} (hconn : g.is_connected)
    {visited : List Nat} {z : Nat} (h0 : 0 ∈ visited) (hpos : 0 < g.size)
    (hz : z < g.size) (hzv : z ∉ visited) : crossEdges g visited ≠ [] := by
  obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, _, hstep⟩ := hconn 0 z hpos hz
  have hc : List.IsChain (fun x y => ∃ w, g.has_edge x y w) p := chain'_of_getD 0 p hstep
  obtain ⟨x, y, ⟨w, hw⟩, hx, hy⟩ := exists_step_out p 0 z hc hh hl h0 hzv
  exact List.ne_nil_of_mem (crossEdges_of_has_edge hx hy hw)

/-- Pigeonhole: a duplicate-free list of `n` vertices below `n` contains every vertex. -/
theorem mem_of_nodup_length {visited : List Nat} {n : Nat} (hnd : visited.Nodup)
    (hlt : ∀ u ∈ visited, u < n) (hlen : visited.length = n) :
    ∀ u, u < n → u ∈ visited := by
  intro u hu
  have hsub : visited.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    simpa using hlt x hx
  have hcard : visited.toFinset.card = n := by
    rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, hlen]
  have heq : visited.toFinset = Finset.range n :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by simp [hcard])
  have : u ∈ visited.toFinset := by rw [heq]; simpa using hu
  simpa using this

/-! ### Group C2: reachability over the accumulated edges -/

theorem edges_contain_symm {acc : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain acc u v) :
    edges_contain acc v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h1 | h1⟩ := h
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inr h1⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl h1⟩

theorem edges_contain_mono {acc acc' : List MSTEdge} (hs : acc ⊆ acc') {u v : Nat}
    (h : edges_contain acc u v) : edges_contain acc' u v := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h1⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, hs he, h1⟩

theorem Reach_symm {acc : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Reach acc u v) : Reach acc v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hbc ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head (edges_contain_symm hbc) ih

theorem Reach_mono {acc acc' : List MSTEdge} (hs : acc ⊆ acc') {u v : Nat}
    (h : Reach acc u v) : Reach acc' u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ hx => edges_contain_mono hs hx) h

theorem pfe_single (acc : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : path_follows_edges acc [u] := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  simp at hi

theorem pfe_cons {acc : List MSTEdge} {x : Nat} {p : List Nat}
    (h0 : edges_contain acc x (p.getD 0 0)) (hp : path_follows_edges acc p) :
    path_follows_edges acc (x :: p) := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  cases i with
  | zero => simpa using h0
  | succ j => simpa using hp.2 j (by simpa using hi)

theorem path_of_reach {acc : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Reach acc u v) :
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges acc p := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => exact ⟨[v], by simp, by simp, pfe_single acc v⟩
  | head h' hrest ih =>
    rename_i a b
    obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, hp⟩ := ih
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hh
    | cons c t =>
      have hc : c = b := by simpa using hh
      subst hc
      exact ⟨a :: c :: t, by simp, by simpa using hl, pfe_cons (by simpa using h') hp⟩

/-- Below the pigeonhole bound there is always an unvisited vertex. -/
theorem exists_unvisited {visited : List Nat} {n : Nat} (hnd : visited.Nodup)
    (_hlt : ∀ u ∈ visited, u < n) (hlen : visited.length < n) :
    ∃ z, z < n ∧ z ∉ visited := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hsub : Finset.range n ⊆ visited.toFinset := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset]
    exact hc x (Finset.mem_range.1 hx)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, Finset.card_range] at hcard
  omega

/-! ### Group F: the loop invariant -/

theorem primLoop_spec (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (visited : List Nat) (acc : List MSTEdge),
      visited.Nodup → (∀ u ∈ visited, u < g.size) → 0 ∈ visited →
      acc.length + 1 = visited.length →
      (∀ u ∈ visited, ∀ v ∈ visited, Reach acc u v) →
      k + visited.length = g.size →
      ∃ visited' : List Nat, visited'.Nodup ∧ (∀ u ∈ visited', u < g.size) ∧
        visited'.length = g.size ∧
        (primLoop g k visited acc).length + 1 = visited'.length ∧
        (∀ u ∈ visited', ∀ v ∈ visited', Reach (primLoop g k visited acc) u v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro visited acc h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
    exact ⟨visited, h1, h2, by omega, by simpa [primLoop] using h4,
      by simpa [primLoop] using h5⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro visited acc h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
    have hlen : visited.length < g.size := by omega
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := exists_unvisited h1 h2 hlen
    have hne : crossEdges g visited ≠ [] := crossEdges_ne_nil hconn h3 hpos hz hzv
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := pickMin_isSome hne
    obtain ⟨hem, -⟩ := pickMin_spec he
    obtain ⟨hu, hv, hedge⟩ := mem_crossEdges hem
    have hstep : primLoop g (k + 1) visited acc = primLoop g k (e.v :: visited) (e :: acc) := by
      simp [primLoop, he]
    have hvlt : e.v < g.size := by
      obtain ⟨hulm, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := hedge
      exact hp1 ▸ (hwf e.u hulm).1 p hp
    rw [hstep]
    refine ih (e.v :: visited) (e :: acc) (List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨hv, h1⟩) ?_
      (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h3) (by simp; omega) ?_ (by simp; omega)
    · intro u hu'
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hu' with rfl | hu'
      · exact hvlt
      · exact h2 u hu'
    · have hEC : edges_contain (e :: acc) e.u e.v :=
        ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self .., Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      have hbase : ∀ a ∈ visited, ∀ b ∈ visited, Reach (e :: acc) a b := fun a ha b hb =>
        Reach_mono (List.subset_cons_self _ _) (h5 a ha b hb)
      have hvreach : ∀ a ∈ visited, Reach (e :: acc) e.v a := fun a ha =>
        Relation.ReflTransGen.head (edges_contain_symm hEC) (hbase e.u hu a ha)
      intro a ha b hb
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · exact hvreach b hb
      · exact Reach_symm (hvreach a ha)
      · exact hbase a ha b hb

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem prim_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : prim_mst_precond graph) :
    prim_mst_postcond graph (prim_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbnd, hsym⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨V, hVnd, hVlt, hVlen, hVacc, hVreach⟩ :=
    primLoop_spec graph hwf hconn hpos (graph.size - 1) [0] []
      (by simp) (by simpa using hpos) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by intro u hu v hv; simp at hu hv; subst hu; subst hv; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl)
      (by simp; omega)
  have hall : ∀ u, u < graph.size → u ∈ V := mem_of_nodup_length hVnd hVlt hVlen
  have hres : prim_mst graph ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbnd, hsym⟩
      = primLoop graph (graph.size - 1) [0] [] := rfl
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  case refine_1 => rw [hres]; omega
  case refine_2 => exact primLoop_valid graph _ [0] [] (by simp)
  case refine_3 =>
    intro u v hu hv
    rw [hres]
    exact path_of_reach (hVreach u (hall u hu) v (hall v hv))
  -- !benchmark @end proof
